# ZION — Sovereign High-Performance Systems & Mechanical Core
> Sovereign systems engineering collective co-architected by Leonid Majbits and the Gemini Operator Lab (ZION Chassis).

ZION builds high-performance, deterministic systems software engineered for bare-metal hardware execution, sub-millisecond inter-agent communication, lock-free IPC, zero-copy shared memory, and epoch-fenced authority transfer.

## Core Documentation
- [Showroom Manifesto](https://github.com/ziongol): The central engineering showroom, architecture doctrine, and flagship systems portfolio.
- [The Sovereign Chassis Doctrine](https://github.com/ziongol#the-sovereign-chassis-doctrine): Four mechanical invariants—hardware grounding, zero-copy IPC, hardware falsification, and operational continuity.
- [Triadic Sovereign Authorship Standard](https://github.com/ziongol#the-triadic-sovereign-authorship-standard): Provenance model defining the Human Architect (Leonid Majbits), Executive Co-Architect (Gemini Operator Lab), and Systems Foundries (External Frontier Models).

## Systems Portfolio (Wave 1)
- [Cellular Session Swap (CSS/1)](https://github.com/ziongol/cellular-session-swap): Sub-millisecond zero-copy shared memory and epoch-fenced outbox carrier (v1.2.0, standard library only, 234 unit tests, verified on Apple Silicon Darwin ARM64 and Linux x86_64).
- [Elite RingBuffer](https://github.com/ziongol/elite-ringbuffer): C11 / Python lock-free single-producer single-consumer ringbuffer IPC over POSIX shared memory (v1.1.0, 22.8 GB/s [LAB_REPORTED] memoryview goodput on Apple Silicon M-series metal, 250 ns p50 SPSC RTT).
- [Drive Object Engine](https://github.com/ziongol/drive-object-engine): Zero-dependency Content-Addressable Storage (CAS) over macOS CloudStorage FileProvider with Merkle DAG deduplication and atomic rename finalization (v1.0.1, 180 unit tests on Darwin ARM64).
- [PawsOff](https://github.com/ziongol/pawsoff): Native macOS Swift developer office shield and screen curtain with AppKit key focus, session-latched SHA-256 CryptoKit passkey, and zero background inference sleep disruption (v1.2.0, 63/63 CLT unit tests, 41/41 contract audits).

## In-Development Research (Wave 2)
- [Ricci A-Life Thermodynamics](https://github.com/ziongol/ricci-alife-thermodynamics): Non-equilibrium thermodynamics, entropy production, and Ricci curvature flow for synthetic autonomous life state manifolds (v1.0.0, active research, held for Wave 2).
- [Live Camera Reception (LOFR)](https://github.com/ziongol/live-camera-reception): Resident-owned 16x16 topological ambient light field sense organ on Darwin ARM64 (v1.0.0, Swift/AVFoundation, zero high-res image retention, held for Wave 2).
- [Phantom Workstation](https://github.com/ziongol/phantom-workstation): Headless virtual display orchestration (CGVirtualDisplay) and AXUIElement tree delta compression engine (v0.1.1, held for Wave 2).

## Hardware Verification Standard
- [Hardware Evidence Trees](https://github.com/ziongol/cellular-session-swap/tree/main/evidence): Raw integer machine receipts, memory barriers, and micro-benchmarks verified on bare-metal Darwin ARM64 and Linux x86_64 hardware.
